componentRevisions.title: Shell, port and gasket
componentRevisions.intent: Separate the bolted visor from the shell. Narrow and darken the lower ring so the shoulder junction reads.

componentRevisions.title: Padded suit and harness
componentRevisions.intent: Build broad shoulder and breast planes, leave a weighted waist and keep tank, hose and harness distinct.

componentRevisions.title: Thumb, cuff and open hook
componentRevisions.intent: Keep the grip over the shaft. Shape the thumb and lower finger clusters and preserve a readable open mouth.

cases.brief: Stocky breakwater intake inspector with a wide braced stance, a raised compact screen hook and a gauge case. Emphasize the upper forearm gesture and show the air cylinder and guarded face.
A broader protective maintenance worker checks a drain grate. Keep a planted near boot, stagger the far boot, hold a compact open hook at waist height and carry the existing maintenance case.
